about: Hand labels for the website with Chat Computer's own model in the browser (Qwen3.5 0.8B, Run my model in this browser), before the fixes: run web-model-base, 4 Nov 2026, chatcomputer.ai at c240eb7, the page's requests answered by the engine's program on this machine (evals/web/run.js --engine native). Read from each trace: what the model was given, each tool it called and what it said. pass = a first-time visitor got a useful, true answer. mode: the first failure, from open coding, then grouped (axial coding): time stamp (it answered the stamp's place, Singapore, not the question); stray tool (a tool nothing asked for: the weather for "hello", a timer for "play music"); bad tool input (a map's box it can't make, again and again); round cap (round after round of tools until the turn's eight are spent); can't here (no tool for it in the browser: messages, files); made up (a wrong fact, about the world or Chat Computer); doesn't know itself; contradicts itself; refuses; wrong day.
